addedSection.title: Community news and editorial perspective
addedSection.text: The Tribe’s FY2025–2026 report describes Media & Outreach as a communication service for Tribal members, programs and departments. It identifies the newsletter, website and event calendar among its channels and says community members may contribute announcements, editorials and other submissions. The report also describes editorial discretion and a final-content approval process. This helps readers understand how one community institution presents information; it does not establish independent reporting, participation outcomes or representation of every Kiowa perspective.
